ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 4 — Focused Visit (Follow-up) — Ernest Shackleton

code.originalText: Ten-week review: three weeks after the stent, lipids, cardiac rehabilitation, smoking and alcohol

text.paragraph: Ten-week review, three weeks after a coronary stent. [S]

Mr. Shackleton returns three weeks after coronary angiography, at which a drug-eluting stent was placed in the proximal left anterior descending artery through the right wrist, with no complications; he went home the same day. He has had no chest tightness since, even on the stairs with a load, and has not needed nitroglycerin. The wrist bruise has faded. He takes aspirin and clopidogrel every day and has had no bleeding beyond easy bruising on his forearms. He has not smoked for nine weeks. He drinks on four or five evenings a week, usually two drinks, sometimes three at dinners. He is impatient to get fit for the voyage. [S]
